name: AI Application Evaluation
outcome: Evaluate an AI-powered application using task-specific criteria.
description: Evaluate an existing AI application using reference cases, task-specific metrics and repeated runs. Work with a structured workflow, RAG system or bounded agent; compare results to a baseline and document failures. No particular application architecture is required.
external: Basic Python, software testing and introductory statistics or measurement concepts.
prior: Ability to implement a small AI application (structured workflow, RAG or tool-using agent); bring or use a supplied application
learn: Create representative test cases and scoring criteria
Compare against baselines and independent reference evidence
Diagnose failures and report variability and resource use
moduleDescriptions: Create a representative set of tasks and independent acceptance criteria.
Use deterministic checks where possible and calibrate model judges against human references.
Repeat runs and classify failures using traces, input cases and model settings.
Report baseline comparisons, variability, cost or latency and versioned evaluation artifacts.
practice: Evaluate a supplied workflow, RAG application or agent on a small reference set.
acceptance: Report baseline and task metrics, repeated-run variability, categorized failures and recorded model configuration.
prerequisiteRationale: Any one implemented application is sufficient to design application-level tests; learners need not study every architecture.
